summary: Built the full jlpt-agent system from scratch: GitHub repo scaffolded, SM-2 SRS engine, complete pipeline script, jlpt-tutor Hermes skill installed, and cron registered for daily 8 AM IST Telegram lessons. Also enriched 1215-word JLPT N5/N4 vocab bank via batch LLM calls with resume capability. Separately, added SEO/crawling infrastructure to the daily-tech-brief-app and ran a security audit with three fixes.
highlights: Built jlpt-agent end-to-end: GitHub repo, word_bank.json (100 N5 words), grammar_bank.json (30 N5 patterns), SM-2 srs.py, full pipeline script (build_prompt → hermes chat → parse → update state → Telegram), cron job at 02:30 UTC, jlpt-tutor skill installed
Wrote batch enrichment pipeline (enrich_batch.py + run_enrich_batches.sh) to fill 1215-entry JLPT vocab bank via hermes chat with resume support via enrich_progress.json
Added robots.txt (all crawlers allowed including AI bots), llms.txt (llmstxt.org spec), and sitemap.ts to daily-tech-brief-app; committed as 405a5a0

Security audit on daily-tech-brief-app: added HTTP security headers + strict CSP in next.config.ts, removed rehype-raw XSS risk, added date-slug regex validation before GitHub raw URL fetch; committed as 13c1931
